findings.description: The plan adds literal seed demo-account email/password values as new keys directly to the committed `app/backend/.env.example` file. Even though these are documented as non-production/POC-only credentials (consistent with the prior authorized `credential seeding` resolution), committing any literal password-shaped value into a version-controlled example file is an avoidable secret-hygiene smell and could be copy-pasted forward into a real deployment later without anyone revisiting it.
findings.required_action: During implementation, use obviously-placeholder values in `.env.example` (e.g. `SEED_KITCHEN_MANAGER_PASSWORD=changeme-local-dev-only`) and document the real POC demo values only in a gitignored `.env` / README runbook note, or generate them randomly at first-seed time if unset. Not a gate blocker; address during implementation and confirm in code review.

findings.description: QA-owned scenarios are explicit and traceable to ACs, and are environment-feasible (repo already documents `npm run dev`/`uvicorn main:app --reload` commands), but the scenario descriptions themselves don't restate the exact commands/URLs QA should run, relying on the reader to cross-reference §10.
findings.required_action: Optional: when handing off to QA, inline the concrete run commands/ports next to TS-13..TS-16 so QA doesn't have to cross-reference other sections. Does not block PASS.

findings.description: Adding `react-router-dom` as a new frontend dependency (Assumption A7) is a reasonable, minimal, reversible choice given `tech-stack.md` names no routing library and AC1 requires client-side redirect/guard behavior. Tech lead explicitly confirms this choice for this story.
findings.required_action: None — noted for the record; no change required.

carried_risks: SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE defaults to false pending the still-open AWS/TLS hosting topology (ARCH-018 open item); plan correctly makes this env-configurable rather than hardcoded. Must be revisited once hosting/TLS is decided.

No Alembic/migration tool exists yet; this story is the first to define real tables and uses Base.metadata.create_all() as an interim mechanism, consistent with project-initialization.json's own prior warning. Recommend introducing migration tooling before the next schema-changing story.

Failed-login handling resolves to WARN-level structured logging only, no lockout/rate-limit, per this task's authorized resolution (matches the precedent recorded in dev-status.json's failed_login_alerting_assumption). Accepted for v1; not a gap introduced by this plan.

config/project.yaml still sets development.require_approved_hld/require_approved_lld/require_architecture_validation to true, unreconciled with DEC-005's override; plan correctly does not silently modify this out-of-scope config file. Config file should eventually be updated by whoever owns DEC-005's rollout to avoid confusing a future automated run that reads only project.yaml.

artifacts/development/acri-66/dev-status.json is stale (still shows stage project_initialization/RUNNING and a superseded Node.js/Express backend_framework_assumption). The plan correctly treats it as non-authoritative for the backend framework decision but cites its failed_login_alerting_assumption/session_mechanism_assumption fields, which were independently verified accurate against the file's actual content. dev-orchestrator should refresh this file's stage/status as development proceeds.

No initial-credential self-registration/rotation mechanism exists beyond the seed script (idempotent, env-configured); acceptable for this POC's 2 fixed personas per DEC-005/ACRI-66 scope, but flagged for awareness if the persona set ever grows.
